provenance.declared_roots_policy: every stored root is a row; no silent draws
provenance.e_ref_partition: kernel totals only (the readout's own root totals); e_total = e_ref + e_corr
provenance.wobble_note: SC-NEVPT2 wobbles ~3e-7 Eh run-to-run (thread-parallel reductions); the committed payload is one draw, the store's chk is the reproducibility unit
provenance.stored_roots_bands: energies 1e-11 absolute; CI amplitudes 1e-8 per-root; the degenerate block's joint projector (p_tol 1e-6, the solver-tail scale); the re-solve angle (davidson noise) 1e-3
provenance.meters: L2/Lz/S2 measured live through the CI-order bridge on the stored draw
provenance.lane_note: the lane rows are the D2h-pinned components (the blocks' own roots; the meters carry their state class) -- the route-invariance anchor is the lane's ground block against the free CI twin's ground root
